structured.approach: I followed the BE-02 procedure in the backend-steps skill. First I read feat.tasks to find the Backend tasks: TSK-05 and TSK-06, both in ap_aging. For each one I checked whether it touches anything external: a service, database, API, LLM or transport. Next I compared the secrets those tasks need with what the tool:repo-access view of the permission table grants. The permission table itself is restricted, so I used it by reference only. To back up the "none required" finding I also searched the ap_aging checkout for environment-variable reads, credential keywords and network imports, and found no matches. I read aging.py and ci.py as well. A stale draft from an earlier run, labelled "attempt 3", was already at the output path. I read it and then replaced it with a complete attempt 1 draft. The replacement adds the code-level evidence and drops a stray tool-result line the old draft had at the end. I raised no access requests because nothing is needed. I did not use the verifier because the output makes only a few statements, and each one cites a source.

claims.text: The Backend lane has two tasks for FEAT-ZD-48600, both in ap_aging: TSK-05 (STORY-05, overdue_with_risk) and TSK-06 (STORY-06, overdue_rows_to_json).
TSK-05 is a new pure function over in-memory invoices, and TSK-06 adds no transport layer (a transport would re-trigger DES-01). Neither needs external access.
Both tasks use only the Python 3.9 standard library and change only src/ap_aging/aging.py, src/ap_aging/__init__.py and tests/test_overdue.py.
The permission table grants no secrets for ap_aging and requires none, so required and granted access match: no gap and no excess.
The existing aging.py imports only datetime, decimal and typing, and reads no environment variables or credentials.
The ap_aging CI runs compile, unit tests, coverage and static checks locally, and reads no credentials or environment variables.
The only external-provider touchpoint in the feature is TSK-04 (Data Science, acme-llm), which is outside the Backend lane.
This is BE-02 attempt 1. The output lists secret names only, and the permission table is used by reference.

structured.summary: task.secrets_scope is written. TSK-05 and TSK-06 in ap_aging need no secrets, and the permission table grants none, so no access request was raised and there is no excess access to revoke. The step should be re-run if a Backend task gains a transport, a database or an external call. A stale draft from an earlier run, labelled "attempt 3", was at the output path and has been replaced with a complete attempt 1 draft.

tool_input.command: cd hobasa-backend-agent && git log --oneline -5 -- outputs/FEAT-ZD-48600/ 2>&1 | head; git status --short outputs/FEAT-ZD-48600 2>&1 | head
tool_input.description: Check git history of backend outputs folder
